name: Sümegcsehi (Hungary)
description: Two equal vertical stripes of white and green, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Sümegcsehi: a red shield with a yellow figure of Saint Michael and a crown, within a green wreath.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
